bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDP has native issuer-controlled burn/mint branches on Ethereum and Solana, a canonical-rollup Linea lock/mint representation, and a Binance-Peg external lock/mint representation on BSC. Structured bridge controls retain the BSC owner/proxy-admin and Linea TokenBridge/ProxyAdmin powers; the BSC external route sets the aggregate tier to external-lock-mint. Native issuance controls are assessed only in mintAuthority.

sources.label: BSC Binance-Peg USDP proxy and implementation

routes.reviewNote: Controller re-verified 2026-07-28 on independent BSC RPCs (bsc-dataseed.binance.org and bsc-dataseed1.defibit.io): BEP20 getOwner() = 0xf68a4b64162906eff0ff6ae34e2bb1cd42fef62d with empty bytecode; token name 'Paxos Standard', symbol PAX, 18 decimals. Same Binance-Peg mint/burn EOA as reviewed Binance-Peg USDT/USDC/DAI rows. A separate Binance-Peg 'Pax Dollar' USDP contract exists on BSC; this row is specifically the profile route 0xb7f8… (Paxos Standard).

USDP on Linea is the canonical-bridged representation: bridge() on the token reads 0x353012dc4a9a6cf55c941badc267f82004a8ceb9 — the Linea L2 TokenBridge (2,227-byte code, read 2026-07-20) — which is the mint authority for the representation. totalSupply $2.0 dust. DefiLlama lists this address in its paxos-standard linea entry.

controls.label: USDP BSC Binance-Peg token owner

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: Binance B-Tokens documentation describes Binance-Peg representations as backed by assets held in Binance vaults; this BSC token is external lock/mint representation machinery rather than a Paxos native liability ledger.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At BSC block 116355472, getOwner() returned this no-code Binance-labeled EOA and mintable() returned true. The verified BEP20TokenImplementation exposes owner-only mint(uint256), burn(uint256), and ownership-transfer functions.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: The generic BEP20 implementation applies no hard cap to owner minting while mintable is true.

controls.capDescription: The generic BEP20 implementation exposes owner-only mint(uint256) with no hard cap while mintable is true.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 116355472, the authored proxy's EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots returned 0xba5fe23f8a3a24bed3236f05f2fcf35fd0bf0b5c and 0xd2f93484f2d319194cba95c5171b18c1d8cfd6c4. The implementation's getOwner() returned this no-code Binance-labeled EOA and mintable() returned true. Its owner-only mint(uint256) and burn(uint256) powers govern the BSC Binance-Peg representation, not Paxos native issuance.

controls.label: USDP BSC Binance-Peg proxy-admin EOA

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At BSC block 116355472, the EIP-1967 admin slot returned this no-code Binance-labeled EOA. The transparent proxy admin can replace the Binance-Peg representation logic immediately, independently of token owner 0xf68a4b64162906eff0ff6ae34e2bb1cd42fef62d.

controls.capDescription: The separate transparent proxy admin can replace BSC representation mint/burn logic immediately.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 116355472, the authored token's EIP-1967 implementation slot returned 0xba5fe23f8a3a24bed3236f05f2fcf35fd0bf0b5c and its admin slot returned this no-code EOA. The separate transparent proxy admin can replace the BSC representation logic immediately, independently of the Binance-Peg owner.

controls.label: USDP Linea canonical TokenBridge

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At Linea block 31737670, USDP bridge() returned 0x353012dc4a9a6cf55c941badc267f82004a8ceb9. The verified Linea L2 TokenBridge exposes bridgeToken, completeBridging, and remote-token deployment/configuration for the representation route.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The verified Linea TokenBridge implementation exposes pause and AccessControl role administration for the canonical messaging route; those roles govern the representation bridge rather than Paxos native issuance.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: The Linea token is a canonical lock/mint representation with approximately 2.0054597191056933 USDP at the observation block, not an independent Paxos native issuance branch.

controls.capDescription: The Linea L2 TokenBridge controls minting and burning of the canonical Linea USDP representation and its remote-token configuration.
controls.evidence: At Linea block 31737670, the authored token returned name() = Pax Dollar, symbol() = USDP, 18 decimals, totalSupply() = 2.0054597191056933, and bridge() = 0x353012dc4a9a6cf55c941badc267f82004a8ceb9. The TokenBridge implementation at 0x4a496167f187a97379e763f693a499ce1182848b exposes bridgeToken, completeBridging, remote-token deployment/configuration, pause, and AccessControl role administration. This is canonical Linea representation machinery, not independent Paxos native issuance.

controls.label: USDP Linea TokenBridge ProxyAdmin

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At Linea block 31737670, the TokenBridge proxy implementation was 0x4a496167f187a97379e763f693a499ce1182848b and its admin was ProxyAdmin 0x1e1f6f22f97b4a7522d8b62e983953639239774e. ProxyAdmin.owner() returned L2Timelock 0xc808bfcbed34d90fa9579caa664e67b9a03c56ca and getMinDelay() returned zero, so bridge logic replacement is immediately executable by the route's role holders.

controls.capDescription: The Linea ProxyAdmin can replace canonical TokenBridge mint/burn logic; its L2Timelock owner currently has zero minimum delay.
controls.evidence: At Linea block 31737670, the TokenBridge proxy implementation was 0x4a496167f187a97379e763f693a499ce1182848b and admin 0x1e1f6f22f97b4a7522d8b62e983953639239774e. The ProxyAdmin owner was L2Timelock 0xc808bfcbed34d90fa9579caa664e67b9a03c56ca, whose getMinDelay() returned zero. This immediate upgrade/admin path governs Linea bridge representation logic, not Paxos native issuance.
